import csvParser from 'csv-parser'; import { parse } from 'csv-parse/sync'; import fastifyCookie from '@fastify/cookie'; dotenv.config(); const app = fastify(); app.register(fastifyCookie); const APP_SECRET = process.env.APP_SECRET || 'default_secret'; let db; // Initialize the SQLite database async function initDb() { db = await open({ filename: 'db.sqlite3', driver: sqlite3.Database }); await db.exec(` CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS merchants ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, email TEXT UNIQUE, name TEXT, password TEXT );
